## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Describe the pain point.

## Proposed Solution

How you'd like it to work. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you've thought about and why they're less ideal.

## Additional Context

Mockups, references, related issues, or implementation hints.

## Alignment Check

Does this feature align with vstunnel's core principles?

- [ ] Privacy-first (no data leaves the user's machine)
- [ ] Zero cost (no new paid infrastructure)
- [ ] Minimal footprint (no heavy dependencies)
